content.short: Ivorypay enables African businesses to accept stable cryptocurrency payments and leverage NFTs.
content.description: Cross-border payments across Africa remain slow and costly, with FX restrictions that hinder expansion to other countries. Ivorypay provides a blockchain-based solution that lets African businesses accept payments in stable cryptocurrencies like USDT and USDC, via API integrations, a no-code storefront builder, payment links, or QR codes. It supports Solana, Ethereum, Avalanche, BNB Chain, Multichain, Polygon, Starknet, ZKSync, OP Mainnet, and Arbitrum.
